chapter.verse: Eite’ thahatna ahi Pasian’ tungah nakpi-in la sa un la, Jakob Pasian’ tungah lungdamin awng un!
La khat phuang-in, khuangno tum-in, a ngaih laiza khausai lasakna leh harp khausai lasakna tum un.
Kha-det, kha-liik, i pawi ni-in pengkul tum un.
Bang hang hiam cih leh, tua in, Israelte’ adingin thukham hi a, Jakob Pasian’ biakna ngeina kip khat ahi hi.
Amah in, Izipt gamah a pai lai-in Israel mite tungah thu piakna-in nei hi. Keimah in ka theih ngei loh kampau khat hih bangin ka za hi.
“Na liangko uh a, vangik kong lakkhiat sak a, na khut uh-a na ciangkhaite uh kong khahsak hi.
Na cihmawh uh ciangin kei nong sam uh a, keimah in note kong honkhia hi; keimah in, a kilang lo vanging sung panin note kong dawng a, Meribah tui phualte-ah note kong ze-et hi.
Ka mite aw, note kong thuhilh laitakin hong ngai un! Israelte aw, ka thu hong ngai hi hoh le uh cin!
Note lakah pasian dang om lo ding a, Pasian dang khat’ mai-ah na kun kei ding uh hi.
Keimah in, Izipt gam panin note a hong lakhia, Topa na Pasian uh ka hi hi. Na kam uh a gol-in ka un, keimah in kong dimsak ding hi.
“Ahih hangin ka mite in keima aw ngai lo uh hi; Israelte in kei’ thu themkha zong zui lo uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amau ut banga gamta dingin amau lungsim khauhna bangin ka tasak hi.
Ka mite in ka thu hong ngai-in, ka deih bangin Israel gamta leh pawh!
Amau’ galte ka zawhsak pak ding a, amau galte lang pangin ka khut ka liik ding hi.
Topa a mudahte in amah mai-et ding a, amaute’ dantuahna, kip paisuak ding hi.
Mangbuh hoihpen tawh note kong vaak dinga, suangpi pan-a khuaizu tawh note kong gil vah sak ding hi.”
